pullRequest.title: fix: align migration acceptance with Bamboo 18
pullRequest.body:
## Summary

Frontend27 publication correctly stopped before npm upload when the strict real-runtime gate found five `/api/v1/sessions/{id}/version-migration` 404 failures. Its source includes explicit Session migration while the paired Bamboo17 runtime lacks that route.

Update the three paired source authorities and the actual published Linux executable URL/size/SHA-256 atomically to Bamboo18 source `d6325a732c7669f94962f604e4ce98966e374d73`, which provides the route and is the requested Bodhi target. Update the existing binary contract test and the stale runtime documentation. A source-label-only update would still execute the pinned v17 binary.

## Test Plan

- 209 focused source-authority, published-runtime policy and executable-admission tests passed.
- Verified the actual Linux ELF against the official v18 manifest: 247,723,520 bytes, SHA-256 `06df1bd069b42c46958dcdb7084c1822a8c2d5cb39d0f95affceb3820bbcc8e1`.
- Ran that exact downloaded executable in an isolated existing amd64 image with network disabled: `bamboo 2026.10.18`. No Bamboo compilation or new download was performed.
- Original source CI and independent exact-head review are required before merge. Real round trip and packaged local/HTTPS acceptance against v18 remain required in the later normal publisher before this dependency is declared accepted.
- Preserved failed publication [40341682463](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/actions/runs/40341682463), all existing frontend27 candidate/tag identities and every product/network/gate/retry/timeout contract. Publisher optimization is a separate #441 change; no publish dispatch is made here.

## Screenshots

No product UI changes in this runtime identity update.

Refs #440; dependency of #438. Keep #440 open until its real-runtime acceptance passes.
